completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Pingat Pentadbiran Awam (Tentera) —
(the Public Administration Medal —
Military) Rules 1981
It is hereby notified for general information that the President having been pleased to approve the institution of a medal to be styled the Pingat Pentadbiran Awam (Tentera) or “the Public Administration Medal (Military)” hereby makes the following Rules:—

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 10
Part 1
PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION MEDAL (GOLD) (MILITARY)
Obverse
Reverse
Part 2
PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION MEDAL (SILVER) (MILITARY)
Obverse
Reverse
Part 3
PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION MEDAL (BRONZE) (MILITARY)
Obverse
Reverse
[S 725/2026 wef 01/10/2026]
